$comment: Corrections to the vendored candlestick.jsonschema.json (foundation-sdk v0.0.20). Sources are Grafana's CUE at the tag in `grafana`. See src/spec/overlay.ts.

multiLane.description: Breaks out each annotation frame into multiple lanes on the x-axis

clustering.description: Sets whether clustering is enabled. Any value > 0 will enable clustering.

patches.why: The candlestick CUE embeds common.OptionsWithAnnotations (public/app/plugins/panel/candlestick/panelcfg.cue:52), so options.annotations is valid; the vendored schema has no such type.
Same: the vendored Options has legend and tooltip but not annotations.

value.description: Show point values on the graph.

patches.why: In GraphFieldConfig since 12.4 (the same patch as timeseries.overlay.json); candlestick's FieldConfig is common.GraphFieldConfig.
Grafana 13 adds the "accessible" line style; the vendored enum rejects it.
